title: UFC Undisputed
notes: Clean exact IPA reached offline account setup, main menu, Options, fighter selection and a live 3D Exhibition bout on ARM64 after the emulator's main-thread timer fix. The test profile survived a fresh-process relaunch. Actual striking, movement, knockdown recovery, pause/resume, audio, completed bout, career saves and sustained play are not verified. Five synthetic taps did not visibly advance the knockdown TAP prompt. Partial only; no full-playability or widescreen claim.

reviewedUserReports.notes: Clean exact IPA on POCO X3 NFC/Android 12 with Super Duper ARM64 Debug, APK SHA-256 f4eca6049dd4f1213f0bfa91ae25fd664578c9060a32cb03079271b276199a8f. A core main-thread NSTimer frame-boundary fix delivered offline Game Center authentication and UIView transition completions; no UFC executable patch. A fresh local test profile enabled the menu. Exhibition reached fighter selection, then a live 3D bout with changing clock/health and CPU knockdown. After force-stop/relaunch, the profile persisted and Options opened. Rating 3/5 only: five synthetic taps did not visibly advance the knockdown TAP prompt. Strike/movement/ground controls, pause/resume, audible audio, completed bout, career saves, long stability and true widescreen remain unverified; startup splash orientation may still be wrong.
